items.en: Search settings, with matching options shown and highlighted in place.
items.zh: 设置支持搜索，匹配的选项会就地显示并高亮。

items.en: Switch between light, dark and system themes from the account menu or the command palette.
items.zh: 可以在账户菜单或命令面板中切换浅色、深色和跟随系统主题。

items.en: Pressing Esc on the uninstall confirmation closes only the confirmation, never the plugin details behind it.
items.zh: 在卸载确认框上按 Esc 只会关闭确认框，不会连带关闭后面的插件详情。
